editorialNote: Original practice progressions. Self-fed and compact drills train contact, control, or decisions; they do not reproduce all match conditions or certify a skill level.

compact-solo.title: Find a quiet contact
compact-solo.instruction: In clear, non-slip space, alternate a paddle bounce and a soft tap upward. Keep the ball and paddle inside a comfortable reach. A net is optional.
compact-solo.qualityCue: Small motion; relaxed hand; eyes on contact.
compact-solo.progression: Add one deliberate backhand tap after three comfortable forehand taps.
compact-solo.successTarget: Count only balanced contacts you can repeat.

compact-partner.title: Agree on a gentle feed
compact-partner.instruction: Check clear space around both players and the net feet. Trade slow hand feeds and one controlled paddle contact; catch the ball before the next feed.
compact-partner.qualityCue: A comfortable reach and a feed your partner can control.
compact-partner.successTarget: Five comfortable contacts each before adding a task.

halfcourt-solo.title: Set a usable lane
halfcourt-solo.instruction: Check the shared lane is clear. Self-feed easy bounced contacts toward one broad target, then collect your balls before repeating.
halfcourt-solo.qualityCue: Finish balanced; stay inside the space you actually have.
halfcourt-solo.successTarget: Choose an easy target and a pace you can reproduce.

halfcourt-partner.title: Build a cooperative lane
halfcourt-partner.instruction: Agree on the available lane. Trade easy bounced feeds without crossing into another group’s space. Pause and collect any loose ball.
halfcourt-partner.qualityCue: Make the next contact comfortable for your partner.
halfcourt-partner.progression: Trade five controlled contacts, then change feeding roles.
halfcourt-partner.successTarget: A short cooperative sequence with balanced finishes.

fullcourt-solo.title: Contact before distance
fullcourt-solo.instruction: On an empty, permitted court, self-feed comfortable ground contacts to a broad marked target. Retrieve balls before moving to the next spot.
fullcourt-solo.qualityCue: Balanced finish and a recoverable ball.
fullcourt-solo.progression: Add a second comfortable contact position.
fullcourt-solo.successTarget: Repeat the same shape rather than chasing pace.

fullcourt-partner.title: Find a cooperative rhythm
fullcourt-partner.instruction: Trade comfortable dinks and easy groundstrokes. Agree on today’s goal and feed speed before adding pressure.
fullcourt-partner.qualityCue: Give your partner a playable next ball.
fullcourt-partner.progression: Move gradually from close contacts to comfortable groundstrokes.
fullcourt-partner.successTarget: A cooperative rally with both players balanced.

solo.title: Repeat one cue, then reflect
solo.instruction: Repeat your clearest contact or decision at an easy pace. Use the final minute to note one cue that helped and one thing to revisit.
solo.progression: Next time, change only one target or feed variable.
solo.successTarget: Record made/attempted only for the target you actually used.

partner.title: Trade roles, then compare notes
partner.instruction: Repeat one easy version of today’s focus and trade roles. Use the final minute to name one helpful cue each and one next practice target.
partner.qualityCue: Keep the feed cooperative; describe what you observed.
partner.progression: Next time, increase variety only after the easy version feels repeatable.
partner.successTarget: Use separate made/attempted counts for each player; never invent a partner’s results.

backhand-compact-solo.title: Compact backhand contact
backhand-compact-solo.instruction: Self-drop a ball for one easy backhand contact into a safe, broad target or upward to catch. Reset your feet before every ball.
backhand-compact-solo.qualityCue: Contact in a comfortable reach; quiet grip; no rushed swing.
backhand-compact-solo.progression: After five controlled contacts, name the target before the self-drop.
backhand-compact-solo.successTarget: Record contacts that finish balanced and reach your chosen target.

backhand-compact-solo.title: Two touch choices
backhand-compact-solo.instruction: Alternate a soft backhand tap and a slightly firmer controlled tap. Catch or stop the ball between tries. Keep both choices inside your safe space.
backhand-compact-solo.qualityCue: Change the touch without adding a large swing.
backhand-compact-solo.progression: Choose the touch from a shuffled pair of prompt cards.
backhand-compact-solo.successTarget: Count only the contacts that match the choice you named.

backhand-compact-partner.title: Feed, contact, catch
backhand-compact-partner.instruction: Partner hand-feeds a comfortable bounced ball. Make one backhand contact softly over the portable net or into a nearby safe target, then catch and reset.
backhand-compact-partner.qualityCue: Meet the ball without reaching into the net frame or feet.
backhand-compact-partner.progression: Alternate a slightly shorter and slightly farther comfortable feed.
backhand-compact-partner.successTarget: Count controlled contacts into the agreed target.

backhand-compact-partner.title: Call the backhand target
backhand-compact-partner.instruction: Before each gentle feed, call one of two nearby targets. Make one backhand contact, stop the ball, and trade roles after five feeds.
backhand-compact-partner.qualityCue: Placement before pace; one cue per contact.
backhand-compact-partner.progression: Let the feeder call the target before releasing the ball.
backhand-compact-partner.successTarget: Record called targets reached; do not credit uncontrolled contacts.

backhand-halfcourt-solo.title: Backhand placement lane
backhand-halfcourt-solo.instruction: Self-feed one comfortable bounced backhand toward a broad target inside your shared lane. Collect the ball and repeat from the same safe position.
backhand-halfcourt-solo.qualityCue: Turn early enough to meet the ball in front; finish balanced.
backhand-halfcourt-solo.progression: After five contacts, alternate two targets inside the lane.
backhand-halfcourt-solo.successTarget: Count called targets reached without leaving the permitted lane.

backhand-halfcourt-solo.title: Backhand shape change
backhand-halfcourt-solo.instruction: Use the same comfortable self-feed to alternate a lower controlled ball and a softer lifted ball toward targets inside your lane.
backhand-halfcourt-solo.qualityCue: Adjust the paddle face and touch, not the size of the swing.
backhand-halfcourt-solo.progression: Name the chosen shape before the self-feed.
backhand-halfcourt-solo.successTarget: Count the chosen shape only when the contact stays controlled.

backhand-halfcourt-partner.title: Steady backhand lane
backhand-halfcourt-partner.instruction: Partner feeds easy bounced balls within your shared lane. Place one backhand to a broad target, stop and reset; change roles halfway.
backhand-halfcourt-partner.qualityCue: Prepare before the bounce and keep a balanced finish.
backhand-halfcourt-partner.progression: Vary feed depth modestly while keeping the same available lane.
backhand-halfcourt-partner.successTarget: Count controlled placements to the agreed target.

backhand-halfcourt-partner.title: Place, then recover
backhand-halfcourt-partner.instruction: In the same shared lane, make a backhand placement and recover to your agreed ready spot before the next slow feed.
backhand-halfcourt-partner.qualityCue: One balanced step before the next ball; no crossing into adjacent play.
backhand-halfcourt-partner.progression: Alternate the two safe targets before each feed.
backhand-halfcourt-partner.successTarget: Credit the target only when you also recover balanced.

backhand-fullcourt-solo.title: Backhand groundstroke targets
backhand-fullcourt-solo.instruction: Self-feed bounced backhands from a comfortable court position toward generous crosscourt or middle targets. Collect balls before changing position.
backhand-fullcourt-solo.qualityCue: Early turn; contact in front; a balanced finish.
backhand-fullcourt-solo.progression: Move the contact position gradually while keeping the target broad.
backhand-fullcourt-solo.successTarget: Record target hits from controlled, balanced contacts.

backhand-fullcourt-solo.title: Backhand soft option
backhand-fullcourt-solo.instruction: Self-feed a comfortable backhand and send a softer ball toward the opposing kitchen. Practice the contact shape; a self-feed does not reproduce a live third shot.
backhand-fullcourt-solo.qualityCue: Relax the hand and give the ball height without a large swing.
backhand-fullcourt-solo.progression: Alternate the soft target and a deeper broad target.
backhand-fullcourt-solo.successTarget: Count the intended target reached and note which contact cue helped.

backhand-fullcourt-partner.title: Repeatable backhand depth
backhand-fullcourt-partner.instruction: Partner feeds comfortable bounced balls. Send backhands toward a generous deep or middle target; trade roles after five feeds.
backhand-fullcourt-partner.qualityCue: Prepare early and finish balanced before judging depth.
backhand-fullcourt-partner.progression: Let the feeder call deep or middle before the ball is released.
backhand-fullcourt-partner.successTarget: Count called targets reached without increasing pace.

backhand-fullcourt-partner.title: Choose drive or soft ball
backhand-fullcourt-partner.instruction: On easy feeds, name a controlled drive or a soft kitchen ball before making the backhand. Start each repetition from a balanced position.
backhand-fullcourt-partner.qualityCue: Choose a manageable shot; do not force pace from a poor contact.
backhand-fullcourt-partner.progression: Move from announced choices to a slightly varied feed that invites your choice.
backhand-fullcourt-partner.successTarget: Count sound choices separately from target hits if the feed varies.

reset-compact-solo.title: Quiet-hand control
reset-compact-solo.instruction: Self-drop a ball, meet it with a quiet paddle face, and send a soft contact toward a close safe target. Stop the ball after each try.
reset-compact-solo.qualityCue: Absorb the contact; keep the swing small.
reset-compact-solo.progression: Alternate forehand and backhand contacts while keeping the same target.
reset-compact-solo.successTarget: Count controlled soft contacts; this is touch practice, not a match reset test.

reset-compact-solo.title: Name the soft choice
reset-compact-solo.instruction: Use a card or spoken prompt to choose a soft tap or a catch-and-restart before your self-drop. Keep every contact inside your safe area.
reset-compact-solo.qualityCue: A reset is a choice to regain control, not a harder swing.
reset-compact-solo.progression: Vary the self-drop slightly within a comfortable reach.
reset-compact-solo.successTarget: Credit a deliberate, controlled soft contact; restart uncomfortable feeds.

reset-compact-partner.title: Gentle feed, soft response
reset-compact-partner.instruction: Partner hand-feeds a comfortable ball. Make one soft response over the portable net or into a close safe target, catch it, and reset.
reset-compact-partner.qualityCue: Quiet hand and a small motion; never crowd the net feet.
reset-compact-partner.progression: Alternate a comfortable forehand and backhand feed.
reset-compact-partner.successTarget: Count soft responses that the partner can stop comfortably.

reset-compact-partner.title: Choose control together
reset-compact-partner.instruction: The feeder calls soft or restart before a gentle feed. Make the soft contact only when comfortable; catch and reset an unsuitable feed. Trade roles.
reset-compact-partner.qualityCue: Keep the decision clear and the contact controlled.
reset-compact-partner.progression: Let the hitter name the safe choice before contact.
reset-compact-partner.successTarget: Count correct choices separately from contacts reaching the target.

reset-halfcourt-solo.title: Soft-contact lane
reset-halfcourt-solo.instruction: Self-feed a bounced ball inside the permitted lane and send a soft contact toward a generous nearby target. Collect before repeating.
reset-halfcourt-solo.qualityCue: Stay balanced and soften the hand at contact.
reset-halfcourt-solo.progression: Alternate forehand and backhand without changing the safe lane.
reset-halfcourt-solo.successTarget: Count soft target contacts, labeled self-fed touch practice.

reset-halfcourt-solo.title: Hold or soften
reset-halfcourt-solo.instruction: Before each self-feed, name hold position or soft placement. Make one controlled contact, then recover to your chosen ready spot.
reset-halfcourt-solo.qualityCue: Control before movement; stay inside the lane.
reset-halfcourt-solo.progression: Change the comfortable contact position by one small step.
reset-halfcourt-solo.successTarget: Credit the chosen contact only when your finish remains balanced.

reset-halfcourt-partner.title: Reset in a shared lane
reset-halfcourt-partner.instruction: Feeder supplies manageable balls within the agreed lane. Hitter sends a soft response toward a broad nearby target, then both reset before the next feed.
reset-halfcourt-partner.qualityCue: Absorb pace and finish balanced; protect adjacent players’ space.
reset-halfcourt-partner.progression: Vary the comfortable feed modestly; swap roles halfway.
reset-halfcourt-partner.successTarget: Count responses that stay soft enough for a comfortable next contact.

reset-halfcourt-partner.title: Soft ball, safe step
reset-halfcourt-partner.instruction: In the same lane, play one soft response and take a small recovery step only when the ball is controlled. Hold position on a high or hurried contact.
reset-halfcourt-partner.qualityCue: Earn movement with control rather than moving automatically.
reset-halfcourt-partner.progression: Add a second slow feed after the hitter regains balance.
reset-halfcourt-partner.successTarget: Count balanced soft responses; note when holding position was the better choice.

reset-fullcourt-solo.title: Self-fed reset shape
reset-fullcourt-solo.instruction: From a comfortable transition-area position, self-feed a bounced ball toward a generous opposing kitchen target. Collect between sets.
reset-fullcourt-solo.qualityCue: Quiet hand and a balanced finish; a self-feed does not reproduce incoming match pace.
reset-fullcourt-solo.progression: Alternate forehand and backhand from the same position.
reset-fullcourt-solo.successTarget: Count soft target hits and note which touch cue repeated.

reset-fullcourt-solo.title: Rehearse hold or advance
reset-fullcourt-solo.instruction: After each self-fed soft ball, choose hold or one balanced step forward based on its height and control. Stop the repetition before collecting.
reset-fullcourt-solo.qualityCue: Move after the shot quality, not because forward is always better.
reset-fullcourt-solo.progression: Vary the starting position gradually on an empty court.
reset-fullcourt-solo.successTarget: Record a controlled contact and a deliberate movement choice separately.

reset-fullcourt-partner.title: Reset against a manageable feed
reset-fullcourt-partner.instruction: Feeder near the kitchen supplies comfortable balls to a hitter in the transition area. Hitter sends a soft response into the opposing kitchen; reset between feeds.
reset-fullcourt-partner.qualityCue: Absorb pace; keep the paddle motion small and the finish balanced.
reset-fullcourt-partner.progression: Increase feed variety before speed, and trade roles halfway.
reset-fullcourt-partner.successTarget: Count soft responses that prevent an easy downward attack.

reset-fullcourt-partner.title: Control earns the next step
reset-fullcourt-partner.instruction: Hitter moves one balanced step only after a controlled low reset. Hold on a high response; the feeder pauses until the hitter is ready.
reset-fullcourt-partner.qualityCue: Stop and balance before the next contact.
reset-fullcourt-partner.progression: Add a second manageable feed after the recovery step.
reset-fullcourt-partner.successTarget: Credit controlled resets and sensible hold/advance decisions separately.

doubles-compact-solo.title: Contact with a clear call
doubles-compact-solo.instruction: Before a comfortable self-drop, say mine or leave from a simple prompt card. Make one quiet contact only for mine; catch and restart for leave.
doubles-compact-solo.qualityCue: A clear decision before contact; every ball stays inside your safe space.
doubles-compact-solo.progression: Shuffle the prompt order after five tries.
doubles-compact-solo.successTarget: Count decisions matching the prompt, not a doubles skill score.

doubles-compact-solo.title: Soft or firm decision
doubles-compact-solo.instruction: Name soft or controlled firm before one self-fed contact into a nearby safe target. Stop the ball and explain the choice aloud.
doubles-compact-solo.qualityCue: One manageable contact and one clear reason.
doubles-compact-solo.progression: Alternate a neutral prompt and a difficult-contact prompt; choose soft when control is uncertain.
doubles-compact-solo.successTarget: Record intentional choices and target contacts separately.

doubles-compact-partner.title: One feed, one clear call
doubles-compact-partner.instruction: Two people, one feeder and one hitter. On a gentle hand feed, the hitter calls mine before one controlled contact, or leave before catching and restarting. Stop the ball after each try; trade roles after five feeds.
doubles-compact-partner.qualityCue: Make the call before contact and keep both people clear of the portable net feet.
doubles-compact-partner.progression: Vary the comfortable feed slightly and let the hitter choose mine or leave early.
doubles-compact-partner.successTarget: Count clear early choices and safe controlled contacts separately. This is a two-person decision rehearsal.

doubles-compact-partner.title: A shared soft-ball choice
doubles-compact-partner.instruction: Before one gentle feed, agree soft or restart. Make the agreed contact only when comfortable, stop the ball, and trade roles.
doubles-compact-partner.qualityCue: Agreement and control come before speed.
doubles-compact-partner.progression: Let the hitter make the call early and the partner echo it.
doubles-compact-partner.successTarget: Count clear agreements; this does not reproduce full doubles coverage.

doubles-halfcourt-solo.title: Call and place in a lane
doubles-halfcourt-solo.instruction: Use a simple mine/leave prompt before a comfortable self-feed inside the available lane. Contact mine toward a broad target; catch and restart leave.
doubles-halfcourt-solo.qualityCue: Say the choice before contact; respect the shared lane.
doubles-halfcourt-solo.progression: Alternate two target prompts inside the same lane.
doubles-halfcourt-solo.successTarget: Count prompt decisions and controlled target contacts separately.

doubles-halfcourt-solo.title: Rehearse a useful recovery
doubles-halfcourt-solo.instruction: After a controlled self-fed ball inside the lane, take one balanced step to your marked ready spot and name the shot choice aloud.
doubles-halfcourt-solo.qualityCue: Finish balanced; one-player rehearsal does not test partner coverage.
doubles-halfcourt-solo.progression: Vary the contact position slightly while retaining the same safe space.
doubles-halfcourt-solo.successTarget: Credit the chosen target only with a balanced recovery.

doubles-halfcourt-partner.title: A clear decision in one lane
doubles-halfcourt-partner.instruction: Two people alternate feeding and hitting inside the available lane. Agree on an imagined teammate’s ready spot. On each comfortable feed, the hitter names mine or leave; contact only mine and catch/restart leave.
doubles-halfcourt-partner.qualityCue: A clear choice before contact; stay inside the shared lane.
doubles-halfcourt-partner.progression: Change the imagined teammate’s ready spot between sets, then trade feeder and hitter roles.
doubles-halfcourt-partner.successTarget: Count explainable decisions separately from controlled target contacts. This is not a live team-coverage test.

doubles-halfcourt-partner.title: Call, contact, recover
doubles-halfcourt-partner.instruction: One partner feeds a slow ball, the hitter calls soft or controlled firm, makes one contact, and recovers to a marked ready spot. Feed the next ball only after the hitter is balanced. Trade roles halfway.
doubles-halfcourt-partner.qualityCue: One clear call and a balanced recovery before the next feed.
doubles-halfcourt-partner.progression: Add a second slow feed after the first recovery, retaining the same lane.
doubles-halfcourt-partner.successTarget: Count deliberate choices and balanced recovery. A two-person drill does not test a full doubles team’s coverage.

doubles-fullcourt-solo.title: Map a doubles decision
doubles-fullcourt-solo.instruction: On an empty court, mark two imagined partner ready spots. Self-feed one comfortable ball, name mine or partner and explain the coverage decision; contact only mine.
doubles-fullcourt-solo.qualityCue: This is one-player decision rehearsal, not a live partnership test.
doubles-fullcourt-solo.progression: Change the imagined partner position before the next set.
doubles-fullcourt-solo.successTarget: Record decisions you can explain; do not award a partnership rating.

doubles-fullcourt-solo.title: Shot choice and recovery
doubles-fullcourt-solo.instruction: Self-feed one comfortable shot to a broad middle or crosscourt target, then recover to the marked ready spot and name the space an imagined partner would cover.
doubles-fullcourt-solo.qualityCue: Place the ball before adding movement; finish balanced.
doubles-fullcourt-solo.progression: Vary the safe starting position and retain the same broad target.
doubles-fullcourt-solo.successTarget: Count controlled placements and explainable coverage choices separately.

doubles-fullcourt-partner.title: Rehearse the middle-ball choice
doubles-fullcourt-partner.instruction: Two people take turns feeding and hitting across the net. Agree on an imagined teammate’s ready position. Before a comfortable feed is contacted, the hitter calls mine or leave; contact only mine and catch/restart leave. Trade roles halfway.
doubles-fullcourt-partner.qualityCue: Make a clear early choice and explain how the imagined teammate affects it.
doubles-fullcourt-partner.progression: Vary the comfortable feed or imagined teammate position before adding pace.
doubles-fullcourt-partner.successTarget: Count explainable choices separately from target contacts. Four players are needed to test live team coverage.

doubles-fullcourt-partner.title: Choose, place, recover
doubles-fullcourt-partner.instruction: Use cooperative cross-net contacts with one practice partner. Before each comfortable contact, the hitter names soft or controlled firm, then recovers balanced. Stop after five contacts to discuss what an imagined teammate would cover.
doubles-fullcourt-partner.qualityCue: One clear choice and a balanced recovery. Keep the exchange cooperative.
doubles-fullcourt-partner.progression: Vary feed placement modestly and alternate the decision-maker after each short set.
doubles-fullcourt-partner.successTarget: Count deliberate choices and controlled placements separately. This is a two-person rehearsal, not a scored doubles match.
